properties.name: A hub's view hands seam_report to the hub alone and fans out seam_coverage; a test holds NOT_VIEWED to the served schemas
properties.rationale: Found by the agent that moved flo2 to 0.83.0, reading service/view.rs; confirmed against the request structs (SeamReportReq takes other_graph_id and design; SeamCoverageReq takes only altitude). The guard reads the schemas rather than a second hand-kept list, so the next cross-design read is held by construction rather than by memory. Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_019Xbw6PG9mXJiU2Sb421fnq
properties.summary: 0.83.0's NOT_VIEWED listed seam_coverage (reads only its own design's seams) and left out seam_report (names its other design by graph_id or inline export). At a hub, seam_report ran once per member against the same other design, and seam_coverage answered for the hub alone. Both reads; the readable set held. Swapped, and a unit test now reads every served tool's schema: a read-only tool taking any other-design argument (other_graph_id, other_graph_ids, base_graph_id, base_path, other_path, ours_path, theirs_path, paths, export_path, design) must be in NOT_VIEWED. Both new tests failed on the 0.83.0 list and pass after.
